name: Trumpeter Swan
rangeDescription: North america from western and central alaska eastward through east-central canada and southward through western and central usa; some southward movement in winter; early extirpations and subsequent reintroductions cloud distributional knowledge
description: Huge white bird with long neck and all-black bill. Immatures dusky gray-brown with pink on bill.

name: Black Bustard
rangeDescription: Grassland of southwestern africa (cape province)
description: The male is a striking, medium-sized, mostly dark bustard with a bold white cheek patch and a reddish bill. The female has a black belly and is elsewhere finely barred.

name: Bare-throated Tiger-Heron
rangeDescription: Wet lowlands of coastal western and eastern mexico (from southern sonora and southern tamaulipas) southward through central america to far northwestern colombia (lower atrato valley), with an extremely disjunct population in northwestern peru
description: A large but rather short-legged, primal-looking heron of mangroves and freshwater marshes in tropical lowlands. Often in areas with trees, but also around ponds in rather open marshes.

name: Maroon-chinned Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of sulawesi
description: A large, long-tailed gray-and-green fruit-dove confined to Sulawesi. Head and most of underside pale gray, with a salmon wash on the belly and a dark, vinous-red base to the undertail.

name: Red-crested Turaco
rangeDescription: Locally in woodland and savanna of western angola
description: A long-tailed, bulky greenish turaco with a yellow bill, a red crest (sometimes tipped white) extending down the nape, and a whitish face. In flight, it explodes from the canopy, showing distinctive deep red panels in the wings.

name: Scaly-naped Pigeon
rangeDescription: Greater antilles, lesser antilles, and aruba, curaçao, and bonaire
description: A large dark pigeon of forests with a proclivity for perching high in trees while still not in clear view. Found throughout a variety of forested habitats at most elevations, generally most common in intact primary lowland and montane forest, but can be seen along a variety of forest edge and secondary forest types.

name: Stripe-breasted Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Northeastern india to myanmar, southwestern china, thailand, cambodia, and southern laos
description: Medium-sized black-and-white woodpecker with a dirty-yellow breast overlaid with fine black streaking. Male has a brilliant red crown extending from above the eye to the back of the neck.

name: Chestnut-throated Seedeater
rangeDescription: Coastal lowlands of southwestern colombia to far northern chile (tarapacá)
description: Fairly common in desert lowlands, favoring agricultural fields, weedy and grassy areas, and brushy hedgerows; often sings from prominent perches such as utility wires. Note small size but with a very stout, stubby bill.

name: Sulu Jungle Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sulu archipelago (pangamian, jolo, and tawitawi)
description: Little-known and seemingly uncommon flycatcher of the Sulu Archipelago from Jolo south to Tawitawi. Drab brown overall, with a long slender bill; note pale throat and belly with diffusely dusky chest, as well as rufous tail.

name: Geelvink Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Numfor, biak, and yapen (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: Localized endemic of islands in West Papua’s Geelvink Bay, including Biak and Numfor. Males have a large, bright “fried egg” yellow-and-white patch on the chest and a hot pink patch on the belly.

name: White-winged Coot
rangeDescription: Far southeastern brazil to eastern bolivia and southward to tierra del fuego
description: Fairly common to uncommon coot, mainly in lowlands. Found on fresh to brackish ponds and lakes and wetlands with open water.

name: Philippine Hawk-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Philippines
description: A fairly large bird of lowland and montane forest. Dark gray-brown above with a rather long barred tail, a rufous chest, a gray hood, and a white throat.

name: Maroon-backed Accentor
rangeDescription: Nepal to southeastern tibet and southwestern china; winters to northeastern myanmar
description: A dark sparrow-like bird with a gray breast and head, reddish back and belly, and yellow eyes. Juveniles are like adults, but with black spots and dark eyes.

name: Galapagos Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds galapagos; ranges clipperton island to northern peru
description: Endangered seabird that nests only in Galápagos. Outside the breeding season, it disperses over the eastern Pacific and usually stays far from land.

name: Drongo Fantail
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new guinea including yule island
description: A medium-sized bird of forest interior, from the foothill to the mid-mountains. An all-black bird with bluish gloss, long tail, flattened crown and hooked bill.

name: Gray-bellied Flowerpiercer
rangeDescription: Andes of western bolivia (la paz to chuquisaca) and adjacent northwestern argentina
description: Fairly common flowerpiercer of the highlands of the Bolivian Andes, above the upper limit of humid forest. Occurs in most areas with habitat containing vegetation over 1m high, including Polylepis forest, gardens, towns, wooded ravines, and tall scrublands.

name: Purple-crowned Fairy
rangeDescription: Gulf slope of southeastern mexico to southwestern ecuador (el oro)
description: Flashy, rather large hummingbird of humid tropical lowlands. Favors forest edges, adjacent clearings with scattered trees and flowering bushes, and gardens.

name: Black-and-chestnut Eagle
rangeDescription: Coastal mountains of venezuela to andes of northwestern argentina
description: Rare, crested eagle of middle- to upper-elevation cloud forest. Adult’s plumage is mostly black with chestnut on breast and belly.

name: White-browed Hermit
rangeDescription: Foothills of southeastern peru to central bolivia
description: Small, orangey hermit of Andean foothills. Orange below, with a black mask, white eyebrow, and green back.

name: Royal Penguin
rangeDescription: Macquarie island and adjacent islets
description: The largest crested penguin, with a diagnostic whitish face. Only breeds on the Australian-administered Macquarie Island; occasionally seen off of New Zealand’s subantarctic islands, rarely off of the mainland.
